gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-gothic: Chunky and cheerful, Junegull pinches its curves nearly shut, while Noto Sans Gothic opens its lowercase counters wide as glass beads. Down a full page, that generous body keeps the eye moving easily.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-gujarat: Retro and friendly, Junegull traces one outline you could follow with a finger. Noto Sans Gujarati leaves large gaps inside its tall a, e and s, so paragraphs of text move along without snagging.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-gunjala: Junegull draws every curve with one pen-tip stroke, pinched shut at the mouth for a closed, retro look. But Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi cuts its terminals back, leaving big gaps that make long reading feel easy.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-gurmukh: Noto Sans Gurmukhi reads crisp and clean, its outward-pointing terminals and low ascenders keeping every line tidy beside the retro Junegull. Closed, friendly letters up top meet open ones below.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-hanunoo: Noto Sans Hanunoo fills most of the line height with open-ended lowercase that reads easily. And Junegull, with strokes like bent plastic tubing, is best given generous size so its loops show.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-inscrip: Retro and cheerful, Junegull builds stems like dowels and arcs like bent dowels. Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian offsets that with big open eyes on every e and a, so the two share a page easily.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi fills the line with capital-sized lowercase, a sturdy contrast to the pinched curves of Junegull. Across pages of text, that sturdy line keeps a dense, steady rhythm.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-kannada: Junegull skips thick-thin flicker entirely, pinching the mouth of each curve into a closed, retro shape. Yet Noto Sans Kannada opens its s curves wide at both ends, so text flows with an approachable lilt.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-kharosh: Junegull gives its y a tail matching the arm in thickness and pinches every curve nearly shut, for a retro look. Noto Sans Kharoshthi lays a dark, open stripe of lowercase for steady reading.
gen-dafont-junegull-gf-noto-sans-khmer: Pinched and proud, Junegull looks like cast iron with a smile. Noto Sans Khmer, with chisel-notch openings and near-capital lowercase, keeps pages of text feeling generous and easy going.
